data.name: Irian: City of ruin
data.detailed_description:
Game Controls

  • WASD - Move

  • Q - Heal

  • Space - Dodge

  • Left Click - Normal Attack

  • Right Click - Special Attack

  • Mouse Movement - Rotate View

Basic Gameplay

  • 'Dodge'(Space) enemy attacks, defeat them, and collect the dungeon gauge. When the dungeon gauge reaches 100%, a boss will appear, and defeating the boss will end the stage.

  • Successfully dodging enemies will slow down time, allowing you to unleash a 'counterattack'.

  • Defeat enemies with a certain chance to receive a healing item. Collecting five allows you to use 'Recovery' (Q).

Game Description

  A 3D action game in a roguelike format. Set various skills and enhance them.

Story summary

  The city of Irian, known as the City of Endless Light, thrived on the mysterious energy radiating from the Aether Core. But the power flowing from the Rifts slowly began to consume the city. Strange disappearances and eerie incidents spread across its outskirts, until a massive Rift swallowed part of the city and unleashed terrifying creatures. Conventional weapons proved useless, and the war turned hopeless as Irian's light began to fade.

  Amidst the chaos, a girl named Saeryeon awakens in the ruins, her memories lost. Within her flows a strange energy connected to the Rift itself, granting her the instinctive power to slay the monsters. She is not just a survivor—she is the one destined to control the Rift.

  To save both the city and herself, Saeryeon must venture into the heart of the Rift. Her choices and sacrifices will uncover the source of Irian’s darkness and force her to confront the past she has lost.

Skill Swap

  Attempting a strong attack during normal attacks 1-4 will activate a special skill. Players can freely swap the positions of various special skills to create their preferred combat style.

Constant challenge

  Defeat constantly appearing enemies and defeat bosses to continue progressing through the stages. Each time you clear a stage, you'll receive a reward buff. Become stronger and climb higher.

Stage Challenge Content:

  Challenge your limits. Each stage presents a random challenge. Failure is fine, but success grants additional rewards.

  • Timebound Curse: Clear the next battle within 2 minutes to earn an extra [Ability Boost] reward.

  • Evasion Curse: Clear the next battle while taking fewer than 5 hits to earn an extra [Ability Boost] reward.

  • Destruction Curse: Enemy Attack Power increases by 20% in the next battle. Clear the stage to gain +10% Attack Power.

  • Stone Skin Curse: Enemy HP increases by 20% in the next battle. Clear the stage to gain +10% Max HP.

  • Proliferation Curse Enemy spawn count doubles in the next battle. Defeating enemies grants 200% more Ether Seeds.

data.short_description: A 3D roguelike action game where you set and enhance skills. In the collapsing city of Irian, Saeryeon awakens with Rift-born powers. Fight endless enemies, defeat bosses, and uncover the city’s hidden darkness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 12400f / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
